summary: Hugging Face card for Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B, a generative safety moderation classifier built on Qwen3-8B. It covers quickstart code for prompt and response moderation, the tri-level severity scheme and 9-category safety policy, and a performance image. No benchmark numbers appear in the text.
